description: Government schools of Pakistan with positions and provenance, one row per current listed school (release 2026-09-30).
notes: Punjab coordinates updated on 30 September 2026: 37,917 of 38,149 current roster schools link by inferred EMIS convention to the 2017 public-school point layer linked by Pakistan Institute of Education. The linked positions have been verified. Current school names, gender, level and roster membership are retained. Read coord_source_year, coord_validation and coord_review_flags. Shared points, name differences, gender conflicts and district-boundary conflicts are flagged. The 232 unmatched current schools retain their previous positions or missing coordinates. Historical schools absent from the current roster are not added. READ coord_method AND coord_precision before using lat/lng: other regions and unmatched Punjab rows still include settlement, cluster, markaz and tehsil approximations. coord_tier retains the original regional grade. in_analysis, analysis_sex and analysis_note describe the frozen September 2026 analysis; analysis_lat, analysis_lng, analysis_district_key_boundary and the other analysis_* provenance fields preserve its positions. The companion distance, coverage and validation tables remain September snapshots and have not been recomputed from this coordinate update. gender is the name designation; in Sindh use gender_official and sex-specific enrolment for mixed-school definitions. district_key is the source district on the 147-district frame; district_key_boundary is recomputed for updated points. Whether a school is operating is as the current roster records it. Compilation CC BY 4.0; underlying source rights remain with their publishers. The ArcGIS item supplies no explicit licence.

columns.row_id: row number in this release (stable within a release only)
columns.school_id: the source's own code: EMIS (Balochistan, KP, Punjab), SEMIS (Sindh), GB EMIS school code; blank for AJK and Islamabad
columns.region: analysis region as the piece labels it (KP (settled), AJK (Mirpur+Kotli), Islamabad (ICT))
columns.district: district as the source writes it
columns.district_key: Data Darbar district key of the source district (successors folded into parents) — joins district_indicators, mpi_districts, school_access_district
columns.district_key_boundary: Data Darbar district whose polygon contains the point; NULL when no position or outside every polygon (coast, border)
columns.tehsil: tehsil or taluka as the source writes it; blank for KP, AJK, Islamabad
columns.name: school name as listed
columns.level: level as the source labels it
columns.level_std: primary | middle | high | other (Elementary → middle; Secondary, Higher Secondary, H.Sec. → high; Mosque → primary)
columns.primary_plus: true for every school (any level serves the primary class)
columns.gender_official: Sindh only: SEMIS gender field Boys | Girls | Mixed
columns.boys_enrolled: Sindh only: boys enrolled per the SELD roster
columns.girls_enrolled: Sindh only: girls enrolled per the SELD roster
columns.enrolment_total: total enrolment where the source gives it (Balochistan, Sindh)
columns.status: source status: Functional | Viable Closed | Closed | Non-Viable (Sindh); Open | Closed | Inaccessible (KP, non-primary only)
columns.functional: false where the source marks the school closed or inaccessible; NULL where the source carries no status
columns.coord_method: gps_at_source | kpema_detail | jsims_mirror | rsu_pin_confirmed | multilaterated | geocoded_school_point | geocoded_settlement | geocoded_cluster | geocoded_markaz | geocoded_tehsil | osm_feature | NULL | historical_school_point_2017
columns.coord_precision: what the position identifies: school | settlement | cluster | markaz | tehsil | none
columns.coord_tier: Original regional coverage grade retained; not an accuracy certification for newly added historical points.
columns.coord_resid_m: Sindh only: RMS residual, metres, of the multilateration solve
columns.pin_vs_solved_m: Sindh only: distance, metres, between the RSU pin and the solved position (NULL when no pin)
columns.geocode_match: the geocoder's or checker's own match class, kept verbatim
columns.in_analysis: Membership of the frozen September 2026 analysis; use analysis_lat, analysis_lng and analysis_district_key_boundary to reproduce it.
columns.analysis_sex: network the school belongs to in the analysis: G | B
columns.analysis_note: Why a row was excluded from the frozen September analysis; a later coordinate addition does not change this history.
columns.analysis_lat: Frozen September 2026 analysis snapshot: latitude, WGS84, 6 dp
columns.analysis_lng: Frozen September 2026 analysis snapshot: longitude, WGS84, 6 dp
columns.analysis_district_key_boundary: Frozen September 2026 analysis snapshot: Data Darbar district whose polygon contains the point; NULL when no position or outside every polygon (coast, border)
columns.analysis_coord_method: Frozen September 2026 analysis snapshot: gps_at_source | kpema_detail | jsims_mirror | rsu_pin_confirmed | multilaterated | geocoded_school_point | geocoded_settlement | geocoded_cluster | geocoded_markaz | geocoded_tehsil | osm_feature | NULL
columns.analysis_coord_precision: Frozen September 2026 analysis snapshot: what the position identifies: school | settlement | cluster | markaz | tehsil | none
columns.analysis_coord_tier: Frozen September 2026 analysis snapshot: region grade from the coverage ledger: A, A-, B, B-, C
columns.analysis_geocode_match: Frozen September 2026 analysis snapshot: the geocoder's or checker's own match class, kept verbatim
columns.analysis_source: Frozen September 2026 analysis snapshot: register the row comes from
columns.analysis_source_vintage: Frozen September 2026 analysis snapshot: when the register was read
columns.coord_source_year: Year of the coordinate source; 2017 for the Punjab historical overlay, otherwise NULL.
columns.coord_source_url: Coordinate-specific public source URL for the Punjab overlay.
columns.coord_source_id: Historical Inst_ID, preserved as text; its leading 1 was removed to infer the matching EMIS.
columns.historical_name: School name in the 2017 coordinate source; current name retained separately.
columns.historical_gender: Gender label in the 2017 source; may conflict with current designation.
columns.coord_review_flags: Semicolon-separated flags: historical_2017_point_verified, name_differs, historical_gender_conflict, shared_coordinate, outside_source_district, outside_district_polygons, overlapping_district_polygons.
columns.coord_validation: Checks performed, not a claim of building-level verification.

source: Provincial school registers (Balochistan SED, Sindh SELD/RSU, KP KPEMA/JSiMS, Punjab SIS, GB EMIS), AJK exam boards and Islamabad OSM. Punjab coordinates: 2017 AEPAM public-school layer linked by PIE, hosted in public ArcGIS service pak_punjab_edu_inst_aepam; retrieved 28 September 2026.
